summary: All 11 acceptance criteria pass. Quick Play card is discoverable on HomeScreen between Daily Climb and Challenge cards. Full user flows validated: join -> search (overlay with spinner + cancel) -> match (navigate to /duel/:id) OR timeout (retry + back) OR error (retry + back). Haptics fire at correct points. Accessibility meets requirements (role=dialog, aria-modal, assertive live region, 48px targets). Cleanup properly handles unmount. Recovery from all terminal states works via retry and back buttons. 26 tests cover all state transitions including boundary cases.
goal: Validate 1v1 Quick Play against acceptance criteria
